column1: # Words the dictionary and the respelled course spell differently, where the course wins (owner,
# 2026-10-18: "The course looks better to me"). Hand-kept, from scripts/wolff_handbook_oracle.py's
# disagreements after each was checked to be the same word, not one sharing its letters (tâas
# 'upstairs' is Wolff's táas, not taas 'tall'). Words the course spells both ways (Doktór and
# Dóktor, Indáy and Índay, Draybér and dráyber) are left to the converter, which gives one of them.
# A stress the dictionary marks with an arrow on a derived form (samukan (←) -> samókan) is not
# listed here: the entry carries it.
